(1) fn_8005D730 @b0: target `lwz r0,224(r28); cmpwi r0,25; mr r29,r0` vs ours `lwz r29,224(r28); cmpwi r29,25` - measured against FOUR source spellings of the local's definition (split assignment, assignment-in-condition, declaration-initializer, and two textual reads placed to force an explicit CSE temp) plus a declaration-scope hoist; all five produced bit-identical cluster lists. (2) fn_8005F0F4 @90: target `lha r0,8(r4); cmpwi r0,0; mr r29,r0` vs ours `lha r30,8(r3); cmpwi r30,0` for `coltype`; the prior lane independently killed a statement-reorder probe on the same site (real 593->786). (3) fn_80062A00 @220/@238: target emits `mr r4,r3` at the end of BOTH arms of an if/else that writes a flag, and pays an extra `beq`+`b` for the layout that copy needs; ours emits neither. In all three the copy's destination is a callee-saved register the value legitimately owns in BOTH builds - the divergence is only whether the defining load/li targets that register directly or transits a scratch.

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: A residual consisting of a target-only `mr rHome,rScratch` (or `addi rHome,rScratch,0`) immediately after the instruction that DEFINES a value, where your build instead defines the value directly into rHome and emits no copy, is a COALESCING decision inside MWCC's register allocator and is NOT reachable by respelling the variable's definition. Signature in fndiff --ops: `target-only: +1 mr` with the rest of the function byte-aligned, leaving you exactly one instruction SHORT of target; rHome is callee-saved and is a register the value provably owns in both builds (often one another local has just vacated). What IS source-reachable, and must be fixed FIRST because it hides this residual, is the companion RELOAD: the same functions typically also show `ours-only: -1 lwz` some instructions later, where the target kept the value live in rHome across an intervening call and your source re-read the memory. Eliminating that reload by reading the field ONCE into a named local is a genuine structural win and closes half the residual - it is what took fn_8005D730 from multiset 2t to 1t and fn_8005F0F4 from 2t to 1t. But the copy itself then survives every remaining source lever: measured dead here against split assignment, assignment-in-condition, declaration-initializer, a deliberately-doubled read intended to force an explicit CSE temporary, and a declaration-scope hoist to function scope - five forms, one codegen, in a function where the identity lever of claim.law.dead-local-identity-reuse-flips-callee-saved-coloring has NO candidate carrier (every already-declared local is live at the definition point). That law remains the ONLY documented source lever for this shape, so enumerate the function's dead already-declared locals before concluding; when none exists, the axis is genuinely unavailable and the residual belongs on the WebFrank REGISTER_ONLY postprocessor path rather than in further source probing. TWO METRIC WARNINGS, both load-bearing. (1) Fixing the reload BREAKS instruction-count parity (you delete an instruction target also lacks a counterpart for), so `real` regresses hard from linear realignment - fn_8005D730 read real 32 -> 241 and fn_8005F0F4 read 420 -> 739 while objdiff fuzzy ROSE 99.3509->99.5724 and 98.1785->98.6248 respectively. Per claim.law.insn-count-parity-outranks-local-opcode-fidelity the parity test tells you which metric to trust: these changes BROKE parity, so fuzzy arbitrates and reverting on `real` would discard a real structural gain. Always settle it with a full ninja and a per-function objdiff read, never on real/--ops alone. (2) Do not read the missing copy as a scheduling or store-placement residual and do not burn the per-axis budget on branch-shape rewrites near it: in fn_80062A00 an apparently separate `beq`+`b`-vs-`bne` branch-shape gap turned out to be a LAYOUT CONSEQUENCE of the same copy needing its own basic block, and the guard-polarity and float-clamp-ternary levers are both excluded there on their own stated boundaries (integer guard). Diagnose the copy first; the branch shape around it is usually not independently fixable. COROLLARY FOR RECONSTRUCTION QUALITY: this pattern is also a useful liveness probe on the SOURCE. In fn_80062A00 the copy revealed that the flag variable is declared and never initialized, so the target itself copies an undefined register - faithful reconstruction of an original bug that must be preserved, not repaired. Conversely, an apparently redundant duplicate read is not automatically artifact: deleting one in fn_8005F0F4 regressed the multiset and exposed a target-only `+2 lwz` pair proving the original re-read the field too. Let the target's bytes, not tidiness, decide.
